description: DBGT v. 2014 - Classe "Tratto di linea della rete elettrica" is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.regione.lazio.it. The class ‘Line line of the electricity grid’ belongs to the Theme ‘Electric Network’, of the Strato “Subservice Networks”, of the Regional Geotopographic Database (code 070301, TRELE), scale 1:5000, v. 2014. The path is derived from the plants and wells visible on the surface, integrated with information from the existing archives. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DBGT v. 2014 — Class “Line line of the electricity grid”" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include DBGT, 2014, RNDT, Global, CTRN. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
